airports.description: Airline routes between the 500 airports with the most routes. Directed: an edge A->B is a non-stop route from A to B. weight = great-circle distance in km; airlines = number of airlines flying the route. Node ids are IATA codes. Snapshot of OpenFlights data from 2014, not current schedules.

karate.description: Zachary's karate club: friendships among 34 club members, before the club split in two. Undirected and unweighted. 'club' is the faction each member joined after the split.
karate.source: W. W. Zachary (1977), via NetworkX karate_club_graph

lesmis.description: Characters in Victor Hugo's Les Miserables. Undirected; an edge joins two characters who appear in the same chapter, weight = number of such chapters.
lesmis.source: D. E. Knuth, The Stanford GraphBase (1993), via NetworkX les_miserables_graph

courses.description: A small sample course catalogue (illustrative, not a real curriculum). Directed acyclic: an edge A->B means course A is a prerequisite of course B.
courses.source: Synthetic sample made for this course

projects.description: Synthetic sample: 16 students and the projects (10) each is willing to work on. Undirected and bipartite; 'side' says whether a node is a student or a project.
projects.source: Synthetic sample made for this course (random seed 7)
